title: VATSIM Peak ATC Coverage Match Rate
dataSources: Flight logs (`flight:log`), flight-plan snapshots (`simbrief:plan`), network sessions (`vatsim:session`), prep tasks (`checkride:prep`), export syncs (`flight:export`).
app: Aviation and flight-sim telemetry — ForeFlight exports, SimBrief flight plans, VATSIM session logs, and checkride-prep trackers — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=vatsim:session airport_class=* planned_coverage_met=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(planned_coverage_met="yes",1,0))) as matched by airport_class
| eval planned_atc_coverage_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - planned_atc_coverage_pct
description: Measures the percentage of peak VATSIM sessions that end with planned ATC coverage by airport class.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which airport class are helping or hurting peak VATSIM sessions.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `planned ATC coverage` on `vatsim:session` events and summarize the hit rate by `airport_class`.
visualization: Table of airport class with percentage of peak VATSIM sessions ending with planned ATC coverage.
grandmaExplanation: It turns how often planned ATC coverage happens for each airport class so you can see where peak VATSIM sessions go smoothly or get stuck.
